positive_activation: A request matching Use when using, validating, or refreshing the local Code Context Engine.
A request requiring a documented outcome in the cce-maintenance router or its topical references.
negative_activation: An unrelated request outside the cce-maintenance trigger family.
A generic repository request that requires no specialized skill workflow.
neighboring_skill_discrimination: Distinguish cce-maintenance from adjacent canonical skills and load only references required by the requested outcome.
workflow_application: Apply cce-maintenance through its canonical router and all selected reference verification rules.
failure_or_edge_case: Follow an exception, prohibition, recovery, or safety rule from the selected topical reference.
reference_validation: Confirm expected_references exactly matches the directly linked topical Markdown references and no forbidden reference is loaded.
